Method of Attack: Detects vulnerability to NSA's ETERNALBLUE exploit by pinging computers with specially crafted SMB packets without executing code
Tests if computers are vulnerable to exploitation via ETERNALBLUE exploit leveraging CVE-2017-0144 in SMBv1 protocol
Indicators of Compromise: Number of scanned computers and number of vulnerable computers found per scan collected via Google Analytics
No hostname, IP addresses, or personal data collected
